name: Send Off
summary: A farewell card the whole team signs: each note writes itself in, and the link carries every signature
about: A big fold-open farewell card on a cobalt sky with drifting paper planes. The cover flips open and every colleague's note writes itself onto the pages in its own ink, pen and sticker, with a scribbled signature. Add yours and the link updates so the next person sees it too; when the card is full, hand it over and it closes, hops and a paper plane loops across the screen.
how: Open the page: the card flips open and the notes write themselves in one by one.
Press Sign the card (or the dashed Sign here spot), type your name and a short note, pick a pen, ink and sticker, then sign.
Your note is written onto the next free spot and the page link updates with every signature.
Copy the link and pass it to the next person; up to 14 notes fit on the card.
Press Hand it over to close the card and send a paper plane looping across with confetti.
Use Start a new card for someone else to make a fresh, empty card with a new name.
